headline: Nigeria Reports 116,563 Barrels Daily Oil Production Loss Due to Outages
summary: Nigeria lost an average of 116,563 barrels of crude and condensate output per day in 2025 due to pipeline leaks and infrastructure outages.
why: Nigeria is a major oil producer; production disruptions directly impact the country's export revenue and global supply availability.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Reduced production capacity directly lowers national oil export volumes.
